title: Benchmark Comparison Report v0.1
description: Turn P6: cross-variant report over the SAME dataset -- one BenchmarkRunResult (benchmark-run-result.schema.json) per variant, plus set-equality/config-difference/pin bookkeeping. This Turn's own schema version FIXES ranking_performed/holdout_accessed/official_gold_accessed to false via `const` -- no report produced against this exact schema_version can ever claim a ranking was computed or that HOLDOUT/official Gold was touched. A future Turn that actually needs ranking/HOLDOUT reporting must define a new schema_version, never relax this one.

variant_run_results.description: One embedded BenchmarkRunResult per variant actually compared -- never a subset re-derivation, the exact same object report.mjs already produced per variant.

identical_item_set.description: true only when every variant_run_results[].item_ids array is the exact same SET (order-independent) -- see missing_items_by_variant for the detail when false.

missing_items_by_variant.description: variant_id -> evaluation_item_id[] present in the union of all variants' item_ids but absent from THIS variant's own item_ids. Empty object when identical_item_set is true.

model_config_differences.description: One entry per variant. When every entry shares the same model_config_sha256, model config was held fixed across the comparison (the intended default for an Agent-design-only comparison) -- a reader must check this array, not assume it.
